captions.text: Deployment complete. The server sends Build 2.
The open tab still shows Build 1. One cause, not every cause.
Page, active worker, waiting worker, Cache Storage.
Cache Storage is not the HTTP cache. Each build has its own versioned cache.
Same URL, different bytes: a new worker installs, then waits.
The old worker still controls the page and serves Build 1.
Explicit approval is this app's policy, not a browser requirement.
Activate: delete only wrc-ep12-v1, keep wrc-ep12-v2. controllerchange fires.
A guard reloads once. A second event is ignored. No loop.
After one reload: Build 2, green. One cache left.
Browser steps not captured here; see the manual checklist.
Deployment and client activation are different events.
An update affects every tab on the registration. Unsaved work is at risk.
